scope: Full7historicalTest sequences/15985frames, official combined TrackEval. Primary IR6/raw was fixed before earlierCGA14Test accuracy; controls/removal choices use complete Dev only. Identical paired/Dev-best cases are evaluated once and referenced by multiple declared roles. No bestTest method/checkpoint/seed selection. This is exploratory, not a newly blind Test.
attribution: Hard cycle consistency was harmful and receives no contribution credit. The structure removal jointly removes local structural weights, validity and absolute-cost confidence. The risk removal removes only (1-p)*(p<.6), retaining structural confidence and feature/logit bounds. These task-specific mechanism groups still require fair modality controls, complete Test and prior-art analysis.
timing: Cached proposal replay FPS excludes encoder/fusion/image preparation. Shared producer timings are not individual-method end-to-end performance. IR generation is also excluded.
